The main takeaway from our work is that
the tunneling transport in the ferromagnetic tunneling junctions (FMJs) is governed by the Fermi level and band structure.

the Fermi level and bandstructure play crucial roles in the transport and spin dependent transport properties of FMS materials and devices, which is the key for the future development of FMS based spintronics.

the tunneling transport and Fermi level of FMS can be well controlled by the bandstructure engineering, and thus we have a great opportunity to realize spintronics devices which utilize both the spin and charge degrees of freedom.
